reading.action: Desperation: push ALL ember energy out at once in a wave at the threat (uncontrolled raw discharge to break the grapple)
reading.result: STRONG SUCCESS (roll 19, one off crit). Point-blank heat-shock + fire-recoil-gate fires against the leeches clamped to his skin BEFORE the cold quenches it — near mass convulses away as one, grapple BREAKS, pocket of cleared water. Raw uncontrolled affinity burst (NOT the Journeyman bar-channel) -> no skill tick; anti-farm cap holds affinity at 6/10. COST: Focus 80->12 (-68 dump, near-empty, can't channel again until rest), HP 43->34 (-9 self-scald backlash cf floor-1 draw), Stamina 50->46. Drove out on leg-strength (Hiker's Legs) to the lip, clawed onto dry stone. FREE.
